# Changelog

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

All notable changes to ModDotPlot Browser are recorded here. The project follows
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/) from the first public tag.

## [Unreleased]

## [0.9.4] - 2026-10-02

### Added

* Added deterministic static 2,000-by-2,000 and 4,000-by-4,000 refined Chr1 detail
  levels for the bundled *Arabidopsis thaliana* example. They load in the background
  after first paint and serve the first two zoom levels without FASTA range reads or
  browser-side sketch construction.
* Added a focusable gray help marker beside **Plot window size**. Its tooltip reports
  the nearest whole number of genomic bases represented by each current plot pixel.

### Changed

* Count only nonzero rows that will actually be written when enforcing the two-million
  row numeric-export safety limit. Large sparse renderer views no longer fail merely
  because their rectangular bounds exceed the limit.
* Renamed **Export data** to **Export ModDotPlot command** and fixed its tabular output
  to BEDPE. Each action saves the BEDPE plus its companion JSON config, whose metadata
  records the runnable `moddotplot -c name.config.json -l name.bedpe` command.
* Moved **Plot window size** from Advanced options into the primary controls directly
  below the identity color bar.

## [0.9.3] - 2026-10-02

### Added

* Added GitHub marks beside both landing-page repository links and a visible publication
  warning directing publication work to the official ModDotPlot CLI.
* Added a second JSON artifact to every numeric export. It is accepted by the official
  ModDotPlot develop config loader and maps the selected FASTA records, visible regions,
  cell size, k-mer length, identity range, exact colors, direction mode, and comparison
  layout for recomputation with `moddotplot -c config.json`.

### Changed

* Preserve sub-CLI-resolution browser zoom in JSON metadata while clamping the executable
  CLI window to its supported minimum and k-mer length.

## [0.9.2] - 2026-10-02

### Added

* Added direct GitHub links for the original ModDotPlot project and ModDotPlot Browser
  beside the bundled example action on the landing page.

### Changed

* Corrected and italicized the bundled example species name as *Arabidopsis thaliana*.

## [0.9.1] - 2026-09-30

### Added

* Added a deterministic, gzip-compressed precomputed default overview for the bundled
  *Arabidopsis thaliana* Chr1 self plot. The approximately 256 KB artifact carries a
  complete refined 1,000-by-1,000 matrix with identity, direction, and support channels.
* Added a same-origin HTTP byte-range source for the bundled raw FASTA. Uncached
  interactions can stream only their indexed sequence ranges instead of downloading
  the complete genome.
* Added a reproducible overview generator and a versioned artifact decoder with strict
  schema, payload, tile-coverage, source-manifest, and scientific-configuration checks.

### Changed

* Made the precomputed Chr1 overview the bundled example's initial view. Raw FASTA
  ranges are requested only when an interaction cannot be served by the precomputed or
  subsequently cached data.
* Made overview loading compatible with static servers such as Vite that advertise the
  `.gz` asset with `Content-Encoding: gzip`. Startup now accepts either the exact
  compressed artifact or its exact browser-decoded payload, with independent pinned
  sizes and SHA-256 checks for both representations.
* Bound lazy FASTA probe and range fetches to the active worker global, fixing the
  WebKit/Safari `WorkerGlobalScope.fetch` receiver error after precomputed startup.
* Removed the bundled CEN180 annotation from the startup fetch set. Its retrieval and
  parsing begin separately after the precomputed workspace opens and do not gate the
  default plot.

## [0.9.0] - 2026-09-30

### Changed

* Added the selected X and Y sequence names to plot hover readouts before their
  genomic coordinate intervals. Self plots therefore name the same sequence on both
  axes, while pairwise plots name the two records being compared.
* Required Pairwise mode to use two different records. A newly opened Pairwise plot
  selects two distinct records by default; choosing the other axis's record moves that
  axis automatically so the pair remains distinct while its orientation can be swapped.
* Rendered exact cells without supporting k-mer evidence with the selected plot
  background instead of a separate gray fill. The obsolete bottom-left exact-state
  key is removed; the **Base** color legend remains available for A/C/G/T matches.
* Limited interactive zoom to a minimum visible span of 100 bp per axis, preventing
  navigation closer than a 100-by-100-bp viewport when both sequences are at least
  that long.

## [0.8.9] - 2026-09-30

### Changed

* Made the bundled *Arabidopsis thaliana* example's
  `Col-CEN_v1.2.fasta.fai` companion explicit in the example-loading path and added
  percentage progress while the bundled FASTA, FAI, and GFF3 assets are retrieved.
* Consolidated per-chromosome instances of the same imported logical annotation track
  into one feature-track row. The row automatically uses the records matching the
  sequence on each displayed axis instead of adding a duplicate entry for every
  chromosome.

## [0.8.8] - 2026-09-30

### Added

* Added a one-click bundled *Arabidopsis thaliana* example on the landing page. The
  example opens `Col-CEN_v1.2.fasta` together with its FAI index and the
  `ColCEN_CEN180.gff3` annotation, then enters the plot workspace without requiring
  the user to locate local files.
* Added pointer-following horizontal and vertical plot guides, shown as dotted lines
  by default. Advanced options can hide the guides, change them to crossing diagonals,
  or select dotted, dashed, or solid strokes.

### Changed

* Clarified the landing-page companion-file hint to identify optional FAI/GZI indexes
  as the faster loading path.

## [0.8.7] - 2026-09-29

### Added

* Added an optional indexed-FASTA path for large inputs. A plain FASTA with a matching
  `.fai`, or a BGZF FASTA with matching `.fai` and `.gzi` files, publishes record
  metadata from the indexes and loads a selected record only when a plot needs it.
* Added strict FAI/GZI parsing and bounded indexed record streaming, including index,
  range, truncation, and BGZF checkpoint validation.
* Added transactional indexed-record finalization. Lazy appends are committed only
  after one parsed record matches the FAI name and length; cancellation or mismatch
  rolls back the attempted record and its retained-memory accounting.

### Changed

* Replaced the ambiguous landing status **Checking** with **Reading and validating**
  and a visible percentage while eager sequence input is read.
* Reused one bounded sequence-ingestion buffer across streamed shards and avoided
  redundant ordinary ArrayBuffer and multi-chunk BGZF output copies.
* Compacted completed sequence storage only when unused capacity is both at least
  1 MiB and at least 25% of used storage, avoiding routine shrink-to-fit copies while
  retaining large-slack reclamation.
* Maintained the retained packed-sequence memory total incrementally across append,
  rollback, and clear instead of rescanning every loaded record for each estimate.
* Unrolled bulk sequence content-identity updates eight bases at a time while
  preserving the established identity bytes exactly.
* Deferred annotations staged on the landing page until the first interactive plot
  tile is available, so annotation parsing no longer delays initial sequence display.
* Kept incomplete indexed-input combinations and ordinary gzip FASTA on the existing
  transactional eager-read path. Orphan `.fai` or `.gzi` files are rejected instead of
  being interpreted as sequence input.

## [0.8.6] - 2026-09-29

### Changed

* Made **Self plot** the initial workflow whenever more than one sequence is loaded.
* Made **Bases** the initial terminal exact visualization and shortened its categorical
  legend title from **X-axis base** to **Base**.
* Standardized the user-facing product name as **ModDotPlot Browser** while retaining
  `moddotplot-interactive` for technical package, repository, and archive identifiers.

### Removed

* Removed the terminal exact geometry selector and **Show direction** shortcut from
  the interface. Terminal exact plots now always use complete k-mer footprints;
  orientation remains available through the main color-mode control.
* Removed the landing-page claims about being vibe-coded, files never leaving the
  browser, and suitability for human-sized genomes.

## [0.8.5] - 2026-09-29

### Added

* Added explicit **Identity** and **Bases** exact-view choices. Identity is the new
  default and follows the selected similarity palette; Bases retains the prior
  A/C/G/T coloring for direct comparison with v0.8.4.
* Added **Full footprints** and **K-mer anchors** exact-geometry choices. Full
  footprints preserve existing behavior, while anchors draw one cell per matching
  canonical k-mer start pair.
* Added an exact-mode explanation, categorical base legend, missing-evidence legend,
  and a shortcut to orientation coloring.
* Added categorical image-export legends for exact identity, base, and orientation
  views, including explicit mismatch and no-k-mer-evidence states.
* Added numerical repeat-rich, tile-seam, even-k palindrome, and browser rendering
  regression coverage for terminal exact plots.

### Changed

* Render cells without supporting exact k-mer evidence separately from valid
  below-threshold or zero-identity cells.
* Hardened exact texture lookup with integer texel coordinates and sized the WebGL
  backing buffer from physical-pixel ResizeObserver measurements where available.

### Fixed

* Defined even-k reverse-complement-palindrome footprints as orientation-ambiguous
  evidence instead of silently painting only the forward geometry.

## [0.8.4] - 2026-09-29

### Changed

* Put every grid preview on one genomic X/Y scale defined by the longest selected
  sequence. Shorter sequences now occupy only their proportional width and height,
  leaving unsupported space blank instead of stretching each self plot to fill its
  cell.
* Aligned pairwise preview footprints with the proportional self plots in their rows
  and columns while preserving reciprocal-cell transposition and displayed X/Y order.

## [0.8.3] - 2026-09-29

### Added

* Added pointer and keyboard reordering from either grid axis. Reordering changes the
  shared record order on both axes and rearranges the completed overview without
  recomputing its comparisons.

### Changed

* Arranged grid self plots on the bottom-left-to-top-right diagonal, with X labels
  ordered left to right and the same sequence order running from bottom to top on Y.
* Simplified **Plot window size** to one nearest-whole-base value per cell instead of
  displaying the floor and ceiling of uneven partitions as a range.

### Fixed

* Corrected reciprocal grid cells so each off-diagonal preview is the transpose of its
  paired cell and its opened interactive plot preserves the displayed X/Y ordering.

## [0.8.2] - 2026-09-29

### Added

* Added a read-only **Plot window size** value under Advanced options that reports the
  genomic interval represented by each matrix cell.

### Changed

* Renamed **Plot detail** to **Plot resolution** in Advanced options to distinguish the
  matrix dimensions from the genomic span represented by a cell.

### Fixed

* Kept the plot-header **Clear** control separated from the plot when the browser window
  is narrowed or resized.

## [0.8.1] - 2026-09-28

### Added

* Added a compact palette-direction button beside the discrete color-count control.
* Added one editable color swatch per active palette class. Each swatch opens an editor
  with a browser-native color control, editable hexadecimal code, and reset action;
  edits are shared by the plot, grid previews, image exports, legends, and display
  provenance.

### Changed

* Reversed the default 11-class Spectral palette so lower displayed identity begins at
  purple and higher identity reaches red. Other palettes retain their canonical default
  direction.
* Reordered the palette selector into dedicated Spectral and Viridis groups followed by
  the remaining ColorBrewer Sequential, Diverging, and Qualitative groups. Viridis is
  presented as a separately sourced application palette rather than as ColorBrewer.
* Reduced the width of the discrete color-count input so the direction control occupies
  the other half of the same control row.

## [0.8.0] - 2026-09-28

### Added

* Added **Back to grid** to interactive comparisons opened from a grid cell, preserving
  the grid's selected records and completed overview for return navigation.
* Added the ColorBrewer sequential, diverging, and qualitative palette families, with
  a scheme-specific discrete color-count control.
* Added separate FASTA and annotation drop targets to the launch screen. A green
  **Explore** action appears after sequence input is viewable and explicitly starts the
  plot workspace.

### Changed

* Increased the bounded grid overview from 256 by 256 to 512 by 512 cells to reduce
  blur without enabling the full interactive refinement pipeline for every grid cell.
* Changed the initial plot style to Spectral on a white background.
* Adjusted the Export image control text so it fits within its button.
* Renamed the release-facing application, npm package, archives, citation metadata,
  SBOM component, and repository references from `moddotplot-rs` to
  `moddotplot-interactive`. The established `moddotplot-core` and `moddotplot-wasm`
  Rust crate names remain unchanged for compatibility.

## [0.7.0] - 2026-09-28

### Added

* Added Self plot, Pairwise plot, and Grid plot modes when more than one FASTA record
  is loaded. Single-record sessions retain a single self-sequence selector, while
  pairwise selection retains its independent X and Y controls.
* Added a grid overview for 2 through the smaller of 6 or the number of loaded records.
  Its sequence selectors must be distinct.
* Grid mode calculates the `n` diagonal self comparisons and `n choose 2` unique
  pairwise comparisons serially as bounded 256 by 256 quick overviews. It displays a
  complete symmetric matrix, reusing each pairwise result as a transposed mirror.
* Clicking any grid cell opens that comparison in the corresponding interactive Self
  plot or Pairwise plot mode.

### Changed

* Feature tracks, Reset view, and current-view data/image export are unavailable while
  the grid overview is active. Opening a cell restores the applicable interactive
  controls.

## [0.6.2] - 2026-08-30

### Changed

* FASTA headers are split at the first whitespace: selectors and numeric outputs use
  the sequence identifier, while axis labels may also show the description.
* Sequence selectors and default export filenames use collision-safe
  `SeqID_FileStem` identifiers, with a numeric suffix only for remaining duplicates.
* BEDPE and CSV omit zero-valued and missing cells. CSV is reduced from renderer
  diagnostics to nine scientific columns: sequence IDs, interval pairs, `ANI_c`,
  direction, and direction support. Exact schemas and formulas are now documented.
* Export uses the native system save picker when available and browser download
  behavior otherwise. Format selection is confined to the native picker, which is
  asked to start in Downloads; fallback downloads use BEDPE and PNG defaults.
* Current-view exports wait for detailed-register tiles (or terminal exact tiles)
  rather than publishing quick-view estimates. BEDPE no longer repeats tile quality
  and configuration digest in each row; those details remain in file provenance.
* SVG heatmaps use an embedded PNG through the Illustrator-compatible XLink form, and
  rotated PDF text placement now centers Y-axis labels on their tick marks.
* Viridis on black is now the initial plot style. Image exports add a vector heatmap
  legend in a dedicated margin outside the data area. Its ANI_c axis is numerically
  linear with six evenly spaced ticks, while its colors follow the same adjustable
  three-anchor mapping as the UI; the slider midpoint is not itself a legend tick and
  the palette name is omitted beneath the scale.
* Empty and loading plot regions retain the application paper color; the selected
  black background is now painted only inside rendered tile bounds.
* Export now keeps a blocking progress dialog open from preparation through file-write
  completion. Complete cached detailed/exact viewports skip the forced-detail request,
  and image generation uses an offscreen framebuffer without resizing or repainting the
  visible plot canvas.

## [0.6.1] - 2026-08-30

### Changed

* Clarified in the normative scientific specification that sparse correction is
  confined to the non-default validation feature and excluded from the production
  estimator and release accuracy contract.
* Updated the design, validation sequence, ADR status labels, README feature summary,
  and release provenance to reflect the completed v0.6 series accurately.
* Strengthened automated documentation checks for the production/validation boundary,
  completed release sequence, historical ADR labeling, and export documentation.

## [0.6.0] - 2026-08-30

### Added

* Added current-view BEDPE export as the numeric default, with CSV as an alternate.
* Added full-composition PNG, SVG, and PDF image export. SVG and PDF keep axes,
  sequence labels, and visible tracks as vectors while embedding the heatmap as a
  raster image.
* Added Save As dialogs with editable filenames and format selectors for both export
  actions; BEDPE and PNG are the defaults.

### Changed

* Removed sparse correction from the browser protocol, UI, Wasm API, resource model,
  and ordinary web build.
* Consolidated candidate estimators, rejected fused projection, sparse policy, and
  sparse kernels under the non-default Rust `validation` module.
* Split export composition/controller responsibilities out of the main UI and moved
  tile selection policy out of the compute-worker orchestrator.

## [0.5.0] - 2026-08-30

### Changed

* Replaced fixed refinement bands with scheduler policy 2, which evaluates compact
  per-tile identity and direction-support histograms against the active display floor.
* Added immediate-neighbor refinement and deterministic exploration so a weak or blank
  provisional tile cannot permanently exclude nearby detailed work.
* Kept 256-register preview quick and provisional, 1,024-register detail as the default,
  and sparse correction disabled outside the validation-only Rust feature.

### Added

* Added a preregistered four-layout exact-containment grid covering multiple sequence
  realizations, controlled point substitutions, repeats, ambiguity, large indels,
  inversion, coordinate offset, and 4:1 cardinality imbalance.
* Added aggregate `ANI_c` bias, variance, occupancy, threshold confusion, spatial
  structure, feature overlap, fingerprint-collision expectation, and runtime reporting.
* Added a stable similarity-pixel golden while retaining the schema-1 numeric-channel
  golden from v0.2.1.
* Added numeric CSV and high-resolution PNG export of the current viewport. Both carry
  complete method, software, scientific-configuration, scheduler, display, viewport,
  and sequence provenance.

### Validation

* The four-layout grid measured mean/P95 absolute `ANI_c` errors of 0.035283/0.226630
  for 256 registers and 0.005333/0.017890 for 1,024 registers. Combined 0.80 display
  floor crossing rates were 2.8604% and 1.1987%, respectively.
* The selective scheduler met its structural comparison limits while refining 63 of
  108 characterization tiles, 58.3% of all-detail work.
* No verified-winner fingerprint collision was observed; the occupancy-weighted
  expectations were below `4.8e-7` per cell for both production tiers.

## [0.4.0] - 2026-08-30

### Changed

* Replaced correlated compute-worker globals with owned dataset, comparison, and
  feature jobs carrying immutable IDs, cancellation signals, and publication guards.
* Added a complete 4 GiB browser resource plan spanning Wasm, JavaScript tiles, GPU
  textures, annotations, sequence-derived tracks, and transient publication data.
* Split FASTA ingestion into bounded 4 MiB shards and bounded progressive axis work;
  OPFS spill remains disabled pending evidence that in-memory sharding is insufficient.
* Made annotation-worker cancellation cooperative during streamed parsing and suppress
  completion or error publication from cancelled imports.

### Added

* Added randomized stale-publication tests, synchronous cancellation limits,
  generation-lifecycle coverage, cross-layer fallback tests, and representative
  haploid/diploid human resource-envelope checks.
* Added predicted-versus-observed retained-axis memory tests and exposed separate
  renderer CPU-tile and GPU-texture estimates.

### Validation

* Retained the existing compact annotation graph after the one-million-record case
  measured 176,000,000 retained bytes and 1.40 seconds including publication cloning,
  both within the preregistered v0.4.0 envelope.

## [0.3.0] - 2026-08-30

### Changed

* Made ordinary matrix requests geometric only; k-mer length, register count,
  comparison width, estimator, and transform are now derived from the axes.
* Made frozen-axis representation fields private and attached the complete immutable
  scientific configuration and stable source-sequence identity to every axis.
* Reject incompatible scientific identities, coordinate layouts, ranges, and
  contiguous-axis provenance before output allocation.
* Isolated legacy estimator selection, fused register projection, and sparse exact
  correction behind the non-default `validation` Cargo feature.
* Split core axis, frozen-representation, ordinary-tile, and validation-only contracts,
  and split Wasm preparation, cache, resource admission, composition, and session
  context ownership into focused modules.

### Added

* Added a schema-1 numeric fixture whose complete tile-channel digests are verified
  byte-for-byte against the retained v0.2.1 source checkpoint.
* Added configuration, sequence-provenance, and contiguous-range mismatch tests.

## [0.2.1] - 2026-08-30

### Added

* Added assertion-backed exact-k-mer acceptance for the real sparse-disabled
  256-register preview and 1,024-register detailed production paths, including the
  current selective composite and direction behavior.
* Added exact scientific identities to Wasm zoom-axis cache keys and field-sensitivity
  tests covering every configurable scientific parameter.
* Added variance, union-occupancy, and selected-configuration pass/fail columns to the
  bounded estimator report.
* Added a generated million-record annotation parse/publication gate with explicit
  512 MiB and one-million-matching-record admission limits.

### Changed

* Accuracy release gates and reports now use absolute error in displayed `ANI_c`.
  Preview mean/P95 limits are 0.05/0.30 and detailed limits are 0.01/0.04 on the fixed
  production path; only crossing of the operational 0.80 floor is release-blocking.
* Kept sparse correction disabled by default after both browser tiers passed the
  accepted `ANI_c` gates without its runtime cost.
* Deprecated the legacy estimator-selection and fused-projection APIs ahead of their
  removal or validation-only isolation in v0.3.0.

### Documentation

* Defined `ANI_c` explicitly as the historical containment-derived ModDotPlot display
  score, not biological ANI or alignment-derived `ANI_m`; validation targets exact
  complete k-mer-set containment, with biological comparison limited to point mutation
  without large indels.
* Added the post-v0.2.0 validation contract and recorded that development pauses after
  each version for manual testing; v1.0.0 is deferred until after additional usability
  work.
* Amended the v0.1 review response and ADR 0004 for the final v0.2.0 memory budget,
  feature-track support, browser-exposed modes, estimator-report schema, and completed
  validation gates.
* Extended generated documentation checks to derive memory budgets, annotation formats,
  sparse-correction exposure, and validation columns from the maintained implementation
  and release evidence.

## [0.2.0] - 2026-08-29

### Changed

* Stabilized direct track reordering: a dragged track now swaps only after its center
  crosses the adjacent track midpoint, preventing rapid back-and-forth oscillation.
* Added visible software-version labels to the landing page and control panel, clarified
  local privacy and project caveats, and made the file-chooser affordance explicit.

## [0.2.0-beta.4] - 2026-08-29

### Changed

* Accelerated streamed FASTA uptake with table-driven eight-base packing, 4 MiB Wasm
  handoffs, compact completed-record storage, and percentage-throttled progress updates.
* Raised the application-owned Wasm session budget from 1.5 GiB to 3 GiB for complete
  diploid human assemblies, while retaining every parsed chromosome in the session.
* Replaced the dense validity bitmap with a constant-time two-level sparse invalid-base
  bit vector, avoiding one retained validity bit for every canonical base.

### Added

* Streaming BGZF support for FASTA and annotation input, using bounded parallel block
  decompression while preserving member order.

## [0.2.0-beta.3] - 2026-08-29

### Changed

* Removed the confirmation dialog after successful track imports; validation errors and
  required axis or alias choices still use dialogs.
* Replaced the simple SVG plot-loading mark with a depth-sorted, rotating B-DNA canvas
  animation.
* Moved X coordinates and horizontal tracks above the plot and the X sequence
  identifier below it, with bars extending upward away from the plot. Status,
  progress, and memory reporting now live in the control panel so the plot pane can
  use the full browser height.
* Made sequence-derived tracks pan immediately from an overscanned cache and clear on
  the same frame whenever cached coverage is insufficient.
* Replaced per-axis import buttons with one sequence-aware **Add track** action. A
  unique sequence match is assigned automatically; ambiguous pairwise matches ask the
  user to choose an axis.
* Made imported-track reordering complete on the first pointer release, added a
  pointer-following drag preview, and made a drop outside the track strip disable the
  corresponding axis copy.
* Compacted the Y axis by rotating coordinate labels and aligned vertical track labels
  with the lower-coordinate end of their tracks.
* Replaced the plot-background checkbox with adjacent White/Black buttons, refined
  control-description spacing, and restored grab/grabbing track cursors.
* Replaced the small drag-away removal icon with prominent diagonal hatching over the
  complete track.
* Centered the plot assembly when the browser has surplus horizontal space and added a
  small rotating double-helix shadow while an empty plot is being calculated.
* Increased heatmap-slider precision to 0.1 percentage point and added a **Both**
  shortcut to each GC% and CpG track control.

### Added

* Stackable GC% and CpG observed/expected tracks for both plot axes, computed locally
  on demand with one unsmoothed bar per sampled display column or row and hover values.
* Local BED3–12, GFF3, and GTF imports, either plain text or gzip compressed, from
  highlighted axis drop targets or a control-panel file chooser, including validation
  reports, exact/conservative sequence mapping, UCSC `itemRgb`, BED blocks, and grouped
  transcript/exon/CDS/intron models with category-aware GFF colors.
* Sequence-associated imported tracks with one to ten packing rows, direct hold-drag
  reordering, drag-away disabling, control-panel enable/delete operations, and feature
  mouseovers. File drops elsewhere in the application are intercepted and reported
  instead of allowing browser navigation.
* Preflight rejection of annotation files in the FASTA landing target and modal error
  reporting for malformed FASTA input, without publishing a partial workspace.

## [0.2.0-beta.2] - 2026-08-29

### Changed

* Remapped identity sliders to the selected palette's low, midpoint, and high colors;
  below-minimum cells now use the plot background and above-maximum cells retain the
  palette's top color.
* Preserved the current genomic viewport when scientific controls rebuild a comparison.
* Removed the high-sensitivity checkbox from the browser controls.

### Fixed

* Extended exact canonical k-mer matches across their full forward or reverse-complement
  footprints, including matches that cross exact-tile boundaries.
* Increased Y-axis label spacing and constrained the plot plus X-axis label to the
  browser viewport without page scrollbars.

### Added

* Similarity palette selection, including ModDotPlot Spectral, Viridis, and blue-red.
* A white/black plot-background control.

## [0.2.0-beta.1] - 2026-08-29

### Changed

* Replaced the legacy collision-corrected b-bit statistic with the validated
  verified-winner OPH estimator.
* Reduced HLL precision from 12 to 10 and default detailed registers from 2,048 to
  1,024; changed the default palette floor to 85%.
* Made sparse exact correction an optional high-sensitivity mode rather than a default.
* Introduced immutable versioned scientific configuration and per-tile digests.
* Pooled both directed strand evidence sources and desaturated low-support colors.
* Paints compatible quick blocks during interleaved X/Y axis construction; detailed
  blocks now replace quick blocks individually as they finish. Detailed work is
  display-uncertainty-selected unless high-sensitivity mode requests all tiles.
* Corrected the multi-seed validation path and expanded spatial diagnostics across
  thresholds, holes, continuity, neighborhoods, feature ranking, and components.
* Removed Phase 0, minmer/bottom-s, alternate-hash, densified OPH, inverted-matrix,
  and legacy base-kernel implementations after preserving the v0.1.0 tag.
* Removed BED/GFF/GTF import and feature tracks from the beta because the subsystem did
  not meet the release reliability bar.

### Fixed

* Made FASTA loading transactional and cancellable so stale load/clear operations
  cannot publish or mutate the committed session.
* Entered exact k-mer mode on the first frame of an initially terminal view.
* Removed redundant tile-array copies and duplicate retained full-sketch builders.
* Restored WebGL resources after context loss and added keyboard navigation.
* Added an actionable compute-worker restart path that reloads retained input files.

### Added

* Exact canonical k-mer containment oracle independent of the production hash.
* Resource admission and total Wasm session budget.
* Real-Wasm Playwright coverage for cancellation, exact entry, privacy, graphics
  recovery, keyboard navigation, progressive refinement, and worker recovery.
* Pinned toolchains/actions, atomic build, CycloneDX SBOM, and complete generated
  dependency-license bundle.
* Explicit and tested `U/u` to `T/t` normalization.
* Automated documentation-note, generated-parameter, and local-link drift checks.

### Still planned

* Sharded sequence and sketch storage with bounded OPFS spill for very large records
* Numeric and high-resolution image export
* Stable numeric and visual-regression goldens
* Broader scientific validation of the probability-based sparse correction policy

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-28

### Added

* Entirely client-side multi-file, multi-record FASTA and gzip FASTA loading
* Independent X/Y record selection for self and pairwise comparisons
* Rust/Wasm ntHash2, OPH b-bit, HLL, containment-derived ANI backend
* Bounded detailed-only exact correction for statistically sparse cores
* Configurable quick and detailed progressive estimates with paint acknowledgement
* Responsive tiled WebGL2 rendering, pointer zoom, pan, reset, and coarse-level fallback
* Similarity and forward/reverse orientation display modes
* Three-anchor 80% to 100% identity color transfer and compact histogram
* Exact canonical k-mer terminal zoom with genome-browser base colors
* BED3-12, GFF3, and GTF axis feature tracks with record and bounds validation
* Byte-budgeted Wasm and renderer caches with compact memory reporting
* Exact, scalar, bottom-s/minmer, and MashMap-compatible reference implementations
* Rust, TypeScript, differential, statistical, and Phase 0 benchmark suites
* Design reference, user guide, privacy statement, contribution policy, and release
  checklist
* Release-facing `moddotplot-rs` project name and explicit ChatGPT 5.6 Sol/Adam
  Phillippy authorship statement
* Preferred original ModDotPlot citation plus structured method and reference credits

### Known limitations

* This is an initial functional preview, not a research-validated release.
* The contiguous in-memory representation is not approved for reliable 1 Gb records.
* Session persistence and data/image export are not implemented.
* Browser compatibility and graphics recovery need broader automated coverage.
